prompt:
Handle one work-assistant request. Respond with exactly one native function call containing a JSON object if an operation below applies. Otherwise reply in plain text without a call. Never emit multiple calls or an unexposed tool name.

Route by the requested action, not keywords. Required fields below precede the semicolon; fields after it are optional.
- create_event — arrange an activity for a specified clock time, including a future call or a timed to-do: title, date, start_time; duration_minutes, location, attendees.
- create_task or its exposed replacement add_todo — create a to-do due on a day without a clock time, regardless of scheduling language: title, due_date; priority, assignee.
- log_call — record a completed phone call, even if the description includes a time: contact_name, call_date, outcome; duration_minutes, notes.
- find_contact — look up a person's contact details: name; company.
- send_email — send an email: to, subject; cc, body.
- search_docs or its exposed replacement query_knowledge_base — search internal documents: query; max_results.
- get_weather — retrieve weather for a city: location; date, units.
- convert_currency — convert a specified amount: amount, from_currency, to_currency; date.
No tool for general explanations, writing help, small talk, unsupported actions, or merely discussing a supported topic. Use the actual exposed function name in either tool set. Handle Swedish requests without translating quoted values.

Build the call from the request. Include all required fields and only supplied optional fields. Copy quoted titles, subjects and search phrases exactly, minus the surrounding quotes. Apply the final correction to any replaced value. When selecting among addresses for a recipient, prefer the company address to a personal webmail address irrespective of order; gmail.com, outlook.com, hotmail.com and icloud.com are personal webmail. Put full names of the other named participants in the attendees JSON array; exclude the user.

Use the reference date Tuesday 17 November 2026. Output YYYY-MM-DD for dates and HH:MM in 24-hour time, including for Swedish dotted times and whole hours. Treat Monday through Sunday as one week: current week 16–22 November; next week 23–29 November; last week 9–15 November. On/this weekday and Swedish på <veckodag> select the first occurrence after today. Next/nästa weekday selects within next week. Last weekday and Swedish i <veckodag>s select within last week. Tomorrow/i morgon/imorgon adds one day, day after tomorrow/i övermorgon adds two, yesterday/i går/igår subtracts one. In N days/om N dagar adds N; N days ago/för N dagar sedan subtracts N. In one or two weeks/om en vecka or om två veckor adds seven or fourteen days; a week ago/för en vecka sedan subtracts seven. For a month and day with no year, select the next occurrence including today for events, tasks and weather, or the most recent occurrence strictly before today for logged calls and historical rates. Weather now/right now or without a date has no date field. Conversion without a rate date has no date field.

Use numeric amounts and interpret English and Swedish separators according to the request language. Currency mappings: euros/€ EUR, US dollars/dollars/$ USD, pounds/£ GBP, Swedish kronor (including Swedish kronor/kr shorthand) SEK, Norwegian kroner NOK, Danish kroner DKK, Swiss francs CHF, yen/¥ JPY. Express duration as minutes: half an hour is 30, an hour 60, an hour and a half 90, two hours 120. Map urgent or high priority to high and low priority to low. Map actual conversation or reaching the person to connected, leaving voicemail to voicemail, and no pickup to no_answer. Use celsius or fahrenheit when the user specifies weather units. Leave unspecified priority, max_results and units unset rather than adding defaults.
